name: Concept Architecture
description: Four walk-in structures from the late spine, each pushing a concept to its engulfing architectural form — not a model in a room but a building that IS the idea. RELATION: graph_basilica (the building is a graph; a BFS light-wave rolls through it). LIMITS: goedel_atrium (a room containing a perfect model of itself, with the statement it cannot prove). THE EDGE: lambda_hall (order wall, chaos wall, and the only lit path is the living band at lambda=0.35). AFTER: rhizome_vault (no root, no center, many entrances — grow sideways).
theoreticalGrounding: The spine's last act spatialised: relation, limits, the lambda edge, and post-crisis practice — each as a structure the player inhabits rather than observes. Engulfment is the pedagogy: you don't look at the concept, you stand in it.

graph_basilica.name: Graph Basilica
graph_basilica.description: A walk-in basilica that IS a graph — node-piers, an edge-beam vault, floor-plan adjacency, and a BFS light-wave rolling through the structure every six seconds.

goedel_atrium.name: Gödel Atrium
goedel_atrium.description: Walk-in atrium containing nested tenth-scale models, to a finite recursion depth. The wall presents THIS ROOM CANNOT PROVE THIS ROOM as a spatial metaphor. It makes self-description and bodily scale approachable; it does not implement Gödel’s proof.

lambda_hall.name: Lambda Hall
lambda_hall.description: A full-size authored spectrum between regular and dispersed forms. Optional recommendation_control adds an entrance rail that moves only the lit floor strip and inscriptions; the rows, their colours and animation are independent of that suggestion.
lambda_hall.qfep_connection: Who sets the relative weight, and who can revise its spatial recommendation? The green band is an authored preference, not a measured condition for life.

parameters.recommendation_control: on/off; default off. Adds LIT STRIP and RETURN.
parameters.recommendation_position: 0.20–0.80; movable floor recommendation independent of lambda_value.
parameters.lambda_value: Authored structure/colour preference; controls the original geometry at build time.

rhizome_vault.name: Rhizome Vault
rhizome_vault.description: Pods and crossing tunnels with no main entrance, no center, no front — glowing root-runners propagating between heterogeneous chambers. Enter anywhere; a map, not a tracing.
